opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead email draft
opportunities.description: Look up GitHub user {username}, open their profile and top repo to collect follower count, top repo name, stars, language and latest post, then draft an email to {recipient} with subject 'Lead for {role}: {username}' and a summary body (then discard it).
steps: On github.com, click 'Search or jump to' and select any existing text
Type {username} and press Enter
Click the 'Users' filter in the left sidebar
Click the result whose login is {username}
Note the follower count and the latest post/README info on the profile
Open the top pinned repo and note its star count and language
Open the mail compose page and click the 'To' field
Type {recipient}
Type 'Lead for {role}: {username}' in Subject
Type '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {latest_post}.' in Body
Click Discard (or Send)

opportunities.name: Person bio + historic homepage note
opportunities.description: Look up {person} on Wikipedia for birth date and role, open the Wayback Machine snapshot of {domain} from {year} to get its headline, then add a note '{person}: born {birth_date}, {role}. {domain} in {year}: {headline}'.
steps: On Wikipedia, click 'Search Wikipedia', select any existing text, type {person} and press Enter
Close the fundraising banner if one appears; note the birth date and main role from the lead section
On web.archive.org, click the URL box, type {domain} and press Enter
In the calendar timeline, click year {year}
Click the first available capture day
Read the main headline on the archived homepage
In the Notes app, click 'New note'
Type '{person}: born {birth_date}, {role}. {domain} in {year}: {headline}' and press Enter

instances.values: person=Satya Nadella, domain=microsoft.com, year=2014 (Jan 3 capture), headline=Experience the NFL like never before with Xbox One and Surface

opportunities.name: Wikipedia lead-summary lookup
opportunities.description: Search Wikipedia for {topic} and pull a one-line summary from the article's lead section so it can be reused in notes.
steps: Click 'Search Wikipedia'
Press Ctrl+A to clear any earlier query
Type {topic} and press Enter
Close any banner that pops up
Copy the first sentence or key facts from the lead section
